behavior: Reproducing IDP-031's surge drill (full make deploy-k8s ENV=staging + rollout restart of all deployments) in staging does not fire either rule, despite limits.memory crossing 80% during the restart. The live drill itself is recorded in verification.md (2026-08-14) -- this verification command asserts the structural guards that make it true: the query shape that was empirically proven to matter (last_over_time, not max_over_time -- the latter caused a real firing on this exact drill before the fix) and the for: duration the drill relies on.
verification: poetry run pytest tests/infra/test_grafana_alerting.py -k 'test_query_uses_last_not_max_over_time or test_rules_persist_through_a_routine_surge' -m infra --env staging --no-cov --override-ini='addopts='

behavior: Killing the emitter (suspending the CronJob) causes both rules to move to Alerting within one for: window, proving noDataState: Alerting actually works rather than just being set.
